integrity: The proof starts from the published explicit monomial irreducible representations, computes each kernel from the shift and diagonal factors, derives every nonlinear codegree, combines those counts with the cyclic linear quotient, and reconstructs the parameters from the top codegree. A standalone checker exhaustively enumerates the representation parameters for several primes and ranks.
scientific_limitations: Only odd primes and n at least two are treated.
The complex irreducible-representation parametrization is prior work; the contribution is the kernel/codegree computation and resulting pseudo-algebra rigidity.
Rigidity is proved within the cyclic odd-prime-power holomorph family only.
title: Odd cyclic prime-power holomorphs have explicit rigid pseudo-algebras
